hero.description: From your very first sounds to your TOEIC goals, Ms. Vy walks with you with patience, approachable lessons, and a path that fits you.
hero.photoAlt: Ms. Trịnh Đinh Thúy Vy demonstrating pronunciation mouth shapes next to a laptop — original photo provided.

qualificationsLabel: Certificates and experience, from her CV

about.paragraph1: Teaching English since 2018, Ms. Vy has worked with children, students, and adults. Each experience has deepened her understanding of learners' challenges and how to create a classroom where everyone feels comfortable speaking up.
about.paragraph2: For TOEIC and conversational English, she focuses on practice, tailors lessons to each learner's needs, and closely tracks progress. Outside of teaching, she loves music, explores ESL games, and keeps learning about teaching methods.
about.portraitAlt: Portrait of Ms. Vy wearing round glasses, smiling amid greenery — original photo provided.

teaching.subheading: A space where you're free to ask, try, correct mistakes, and keep moving forward.
teaching.imageDisclosure: These two classroom photos show Ms. Vy's real teaching sessions.

approaches.title: Learn from what you need
approaches.text: Methods and materials are tailored to each learner's level, needs, and learning style.

approaches.title: Practice to grow more confident
approaches.text: Pronunciation drills, dictation, shadowing, and conversation practice through everyday, relatable situations.

approaches.title: See your own progress
approaches.text: Track your learning journey, spot challenges, and get feedback so you know exactly what to practice next.

classroomImages.alt: Photo of Ms. Vy guiding three adult learners reviewing an English exercise together.
classroomImages.title: Understanding together, progressing together
classroomImages.description: Discussing, asking questions, and taking the time to understand every part of the lesson.

classroomImages.alt: Photo of Ms. Vy guiding an adult learner through pronunciation practice.
classroomImages.title: Confidence from the very first sounds
classroomImages.description: Listening, practicing pronunciation, and step by step bringing English into real conversation.

background.communityNoteText: In 2019, she volunteered as an interpreter at Friends for Street Children and taught conversational English to students in a summer program.
